name: Dragon, Radiant
body:
RADIANT DRAGON, VERY YOUNG
CR 4

This dragon glows with a soft yellow light, and displays a gentle smile despite brutal fangs and claws.

XP 1,200
NG Small dragon (good)
Init +5; Senses dragon senses; Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+1 Dex, +5 natural, +1 size)
hp 37 (5d12+5); fast healing 1
Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +7
Immune paralysis, sleep
Weaknesses Vulnerability to negative energy

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)
Melee bite +7 (1d6+1), 2 claws +7 (1d4+1)
Special Attacks breath weapon (20-ft. cone, DC 12, 4d4 positive energy, 7/day)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th; concentration +8)

2nd (5/day)–aid, bull’s strength, lesser restoration
1st (7/day)–cause fear (DC 14), cure light wounds, murderous command (DC 14), obscuring mist, remove fear
0 (At will)–create water, detect poison, guidance, light, purify food and drink (DC 13), stabilize

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 12, Con 11, Int 8, Wis 13, Cha 16
Base Atk +5; CMB +6; CMD 17 (21 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Toughness
Skills Diplomacy +11, Fly +9, Heal +9, Knowledge (religion) +7, Spellcraft +7, Stealth +5
Languages Draconic, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Breath Weapon (Su)

A radiant dragon may use her breath weapon a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Charisma modifier. The positive energy breath weapon simultaneously heals all living creatures and damages all undead creatures within its area of effect. A radiant dragon’s breath weapon also heals the radiant dragon.

Dragon Senses (Ex)

Dragons have darkvision 120 ft. and blindsense 60 ft. They see four times as well as a human in dim light and twice as well in normal light.
